headline: Budget 2027: Can the European Union impose reforms on France?
summary: Prime Minister Vasile Tofan said the government is dropping a plan to raise VAT on certain agricultural products. The plan was part of a fiscal package to raise budget revenue and had sparked farmer protests.
why: Agriculture is a major part of Moldova's economy, and tax changes on farm goods affect producer incomes and state revenue.
